en: Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a busy riverside or port scene with piles of postal parcels in the foreground and workers handling them. In the middle distance there is a small white building with a sign on its roof, and a crowd of civilians and uniformed men gathered near a fenced area with trees behind. A handwritten caption runs across the top of the image in a Nordic language, dated 1917 and mentioning Haparanda.
